subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw adopt native outbound Telegram album sending now, using the open fork PR as the starting point, or keep sequential multi-media fan-out until maintainers define a narrower channel contract?
rationale: This is a new visible Telegram capability with an open implementation candidate and several closed prior attempts, so automation should not choose the action/API shape or supersede contributor work without maintainer intent.

options.title: Review or port the fork PR
options.body: Use the open fork PR as the starting point, update it for current Telegram plugin boundaries, and require focused tests plus live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Define the album contract first
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers specify which surfaces, media kinds, captions, buttons, and reply/thread behaviors should use native albums.

options.title: Defer native album grouping
options.body: Document current sequential `mediaUrls` fan-out as the supported behavior for now and explicitly defer Telegram album semantics.

recommendation.title: Review or port the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the open fork PR as the starting point, update it for current Telegram plugin boundaries, and require focused tests plus live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already handled prior cleanup review here and has recent history across the Telegram send/action surfaces and product-boundary refactors.
